feedback.worked_solution:
We already know that

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =-3{x}^{2}-6x+24.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the second derivative, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{″}(x) & ={(-3{x}^{2}-6x+24)}^{′} \\  & =-3\cdot 2x-6\cdot 1+0 \\  & =-6x-6.\end{aligned}
$$
